source.author: verg
source.text: At illum curvata in montis faciem circumstetit unda accepitque sinu vasto misitque sub amnem.
source.text_original: At illum / curvata in montis faciem circumstetit unda / accepitque sinu vasto misitque sub amnem.
source.text_english: But the curving water stood round him in the shape of a mountain and, receiving him in its broad hollow, sent him beneath the stream.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: transiecit enim populum medio mari rubro praecedente angelo et scindente aquam, ut populus per siccum gradi posset, quem uerius, ut ait poeta, curuata in montis faciem circumstetit unda .
reuse.text_original: transiecit enim populum medio mari rubro praecedente angelo et scindente aquam, ut populus per siccum gradi posset, quem uerius, ut ait poeta, curuata in montis faciem circumstetit unda .
reuse.text_english: For he led the people across through the middle of the Red Sea, an angel going before and dividing the water, so that the people might walk through on dry ground; as the poet says more truly, the wave bent into the likeness of a mountain stood round about them.
